notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Modify Lookahead implementation to the official C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the exact signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors, including an acceptance-timed service-report regression for a lower requested lookahead that remains deferred in actual state, plus narrow process-local restore rollbacks for a post-save increase and a deferred decrease target. It is not catalog evidence, protected-review evidence, package support, or a conformance claim.
